CIV.note: The document states nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.
The document describes a planned AI and big data laboratory, not a government AI system piloted or in use.
No AI tool in a public sector's system is stated.

facts.fact: Comdisrupt reports that the Ministry of Digital Transition published on 13 April 2026 tender IAS n°01/2026/PARAE, financed by an African Development Bank loan, for equipment for an AI and big data laboratory under the PARAE e-government project, with 180-day delivery.
